title: An Open-Meteo sample stamped 0001-01-01 fails every solve: IrradianceSeries.mean_over overflows outside the fence
claim: _parse_block keeps a sample stamped '0001-01-01T00:00', and IrradianceSeries.mean_over then raises OverflowError on `t - self.resolution` for every plan step, so every solve fails ('Optimization failed: date value out of range') for as long as the series is held, with last_update_success staying True.
mechanism: OpenMeteoSolar.async_refresh fences only the fetch+parse (`_fenced`, #1519: 'never raises ... by construction'); the parsed series is stored, and the read side (`irradiance_for` -> `mean_over`, called per step by `_apply_open_meteo` inside the solve-input build) computes `sample_start = t - self.resolution` for every sample. datetime.min - 1 h raises OverflowError; async_run_optimization's broad handler books it as a solve failure (logged once by log_held, counted in _solve_failures), the last plan stays published and the update reports success. The series is replaced only by a later non-empty forecast, so a feed that keeps the stamp fails every cycle.

evidence.machine: orchestrator Mac, Apple M1 (darwin arm64, 8 cores), shared box

instrumented_symbol: heatpump_optimizer.open_meteo:IrradianceSeries.mean_over (driven through OpenMeteoSolar.async_refresh -> _parse_block and HeatPumpOptimizerCoordinator.async_refresh; read off coordinator._solve_failures)

perturbation.change: mean_over returns None (not covered) instead of raising OverflowError on an out-of-range sample (`--perturb openmeteo_overflow_guard`, mock.patch.object wrapper)

metric_definition: coordinator._solve_failures after 3 refreshes with solar_forecast_source=open_meteo and a forecast body whose hourly block carries two 0001-01-01 samples before 72 valid ones.
phenomenon_property: A parsed external series never raises on read: every instant kept by an external-feed parser is one the read-side arithmetic (t - resolution, t + step) can carry, or the sample is dropped at parse.

null_control.note: the same 72 valid samples without the two year-1 stamps: 0 failed solves; nan, string, unsorted/duplicate, non-dict and error bodies also 0

proposed_fix_scope: open_meteo._parse_block: drop a sample whose stamp minus one resolution (or minus the plan step) is out of datetime range, or bound stamps to a plausible window around now; open_meteo.py only.
